title: Understand Cluster Manager, Peers, RF, and SF
objectives: Understand Cluster Manager, Peers, RF, and SF
Verify actual state through a separate inspection or query.

tasks.instruction: Open Settings → Indexer clustering and inspect the manager, peers, bucket copies, RF and SF. This lesson retains the profile topology and supplies three explicit source_logs records.

In Terminal, ssh splunk@cm01, then run splunk show cluster-status --verbose and splunk list cluster-peers. Compare the actual peer count and coverage with Web. Explain why RF counts copies and SF counts searchable copies.

hints: Inspect running versus disk source and use the correct component.
Keep the fixture clock paused and advance deliberately to observe transitions.
